name: kind-operation-scoped-runtime-readiness-reports
instr:
kind cannot report whether cluster creation or image loading is ready before side effects begin. Add deterministic, non-mutating, operation-scoped readiness reporting so command-line and library decisions match the operation they precede.

Reports identify the operation, selected backend, ordered attempts and findings, and are blocked exactly by error-severity findings. Findings use stable cross-backend codes, preserve backend-specific meaning, include sanitized command evidence, and sort by attempt, phase, severity, and code. Docker distinguishes binary recognition, daemon reachability, rootless security mode, storage-driver implications, and all conflicting duplicate-network identifiers using Docker-compatible output. nerdctl and Finch preserve the selected executable's identity, daemon, namespace, rootless, and operation semantics. Podman distinguishes binary recognition, minimum version, daemon information, rootless mode, and version-dependent operation and volume limitations.
Docker rootless mode and the devicemapper storage driver produce warnings. A non-default nerdctl namespace blocks readiness, while nerdctl rootless mode warns. Rootless Podman load-image checks warn about volume limitations, and Podman versions before 2.0 block load-image readiness.

Inspection must not mutate runtime resources. Create-cluster network conflicts use `network-conflict`. Validate every load-image reference before backend inspection or image handling; any invalid image stops inspection,
